rules.message: Checklist B7: every model element has a phase
Checklist B6: underlays and grids pinned
rules.fix: Select the underlay(s)/grids and pin them (PN).

rules.message: Checklist B5: project base point pinned
rules.fix: Pin the project base point after acquiring coordinates.
Never move the survey point; put it back or ask the application manager.

rules.message: Project base point on rounded grid values
rules.fix: Round N/S and E/W of the project base point (e.g. whole metres) and pin it.

rules.message: Table 2: a view's phase and phase filter start with the same digit
rules.fix: Pick a phase filter with the same leading digit as the phase.

rules.message: New work in a view on the existing phase
rules.fix: Work in a view on 2. New construction ('view plan' creates one).

rules.message: Checklist D1: plot views keep their view template
rules.fix: Assign the matching EX_P_* view template.

rules.message: Checklist B10: families from the template or the office library
rules.fix: Use a template family or 'library <term>'; new families from the office family templates.

rules.message: Checklist E1: object code filled on new work
rules.fix: Fill EX_ObjectCode and EX_ObjectDescription with 'set <id> EX_ObjectCode <code>'.

rules.message: The pile schedule counts new work only
rules.fix: Set the schedule to phase 2. New construction with filter 2.7 New only.

rules.message: Checklist D2: underlays linked, not imported
rules.fix: Delete the import and link the file with 'linkcad'.
